name: Sentinel of the Third King
place: dungeon glass_tomb (Tomb of the Glass Kings): mini-boss
_doc: The obsidian guard at the third king's grave. P1 "On Guard": a halberd sweep, a spear thrust line, and the King's Glare — sunlight focused through the tomb roof that only the three glass grave-markers block (hide behind one; it cracks). P2 at 50% "Breaking the Markers": it smashes its way through the markers (each slam breaks the ones it hits), so the hiding places run out — finish it fast.
party: Solo: use the markers one at a time. 2-3: everyone behind the same marker cracks it fast — share them out. 5: two to a marker.

pull: "The third king sleeps. You will not wake him."
The Sentinel lowers its halberd. Sand pours from the joints.
say.death: The Sentinel kneels at the grave it kept, and stays there.
say.reset: The Sentinel takes up its post by the third king again.

enrage.say: The Sentinel glows with stored sunlight!

glare.name: King's Glare
glare.say: Light floods down through the roof — get behind a grave-marker!

marker_slam.name: Marker Slam
marker_slam.say: It slams the ground — the markers crack!

do.say: The last marker shatters. Nothing stands between you and the light.
